This '''clone trooper''' was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he led a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] to rescue 25 [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] that had been captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="25toRescue" />
